What is hyprland-preview-share-picker-git?

This is the git/development-snapshot build of hyprland-preview-share-picker, Hyprland's alternative screen-share picker. It replaces the default text-only picker with live thumbnail previews of open windows and connected monitors in a tabbed GTK4 window, so you can confirm what you're sharing before a call or recording starts. Being the -git package, it tracks the latest unreleased commits rather than a tagged release.

Install hyprland-preview-share-picker-git on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add hyprland-preview-share-picker-git

Good to know

  • Hyprland window manager
  • xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
  • GTK4 and GTK4 Layer Shell installed
  • slurp (optional, for manual region selection)
  • Rust nightly toolchain to build from source
